latest.title: Operational Update
latest.content:
Today 08:31
RNS Number : 1848V
Empyrean Energy PLC
17 September 2026
17 September 2026
This announcement contains inside information
Empyrean Energy PLC / Index: AIM / Epic: EME / Sector: Oil & Gas
Empyrean Energy PLC (‘Empyrean’ or ‘the Company’)
Operational Update
Empyrean Energy plc (
“Empyrean”
or the
“Company”
), the oil and gas exploration and development company with interests in Austria, Indonesia, and the United States, is pleased to provide an update on progress at the
Duyung PSC and the Mako Gas Field in Indonesia (
“Mako Gas Project”
).
Conrad Asia Energy Ltd
(“Conrad’, (ASX:CRD))
and its majority-owned subsidiary, West Natuna Exploration Limited (“
WNEL
”), as operator of the Duyung PSC, today advised that several critical milestones have recently been completed, and the project remains on budget and on track to complete construction and begin production in the fourth quarter of 2027.
Subject to the completion of documentation, as detailed in the announcement on 10 September 2026,
Empyrean is entitled to 8.5% of all cash payments to WNEL including revenue from gas sales from Mako
.
These critical milestones are outlined below.
Highlights
As reported previously, contracts had been signed earlier this year for (i) the Mobile Offshore Production Unit (“
MOPU
”), (ii) the drilling rig, (iii) the Conductor Support Frame (“
CSF
”), (iv) the Subsea Umbilical, Riser, and Flowline (“
SURF
”) and (v) multiple supporting facilities and services. Below are the updates on these workstreams.
MOPU:
contract with PT Duta Marine/PT Pakarti Tirtoagung (“
PT DM
”) for the provision of a leased MOPU unit, with the scope of work including (i) sourcing and conversion of a donor jack-up drilling rig to a MOPU in Batam, with a raw gas design capacity of 172 mmscfd, (ii) mobilisation to site, (iii) bareboat charter until end of current PSC term (Jan 2037) plus five annual extension options, (iv) operations and maintenance of the MOPU, and (v) demobilisation back to Batam and the end of the contract life.
The donor jack-up drilling rig,
Valaris 104
, to be converted and used as Mako MOPU, has been successfully wet-towed through the Strait of Hormuz and loaded onto a dry-tow vessel for transport to Batam, Indonesia, for conversion. The rig is expected to reach the yard by end 3Q 26 as planned.
Key equipment for the MOPU includes the compression system. Factory Acceptance Testing (“
FAT
”) of the key 17Mw and 10Mw motors has been completed in Germany. Transportation of the units from Germany to Batam is slated for early 4Q 26. The compressor FAT is set for mid-Q4 26 in San Diego, with shipment expected to commence in the same quarter.
Fabrication by PT DM is expected to commence before the end of September 2026 at the PaxOcean Yard, Batam, with an official ceremony planned for later in the quarter.
The contract remains on track.
Drilling Rig:
contract with PT Pertamina Drilling Services Indonesia, through the PDSI – ADES Consortium, for a firm period of 180 days, with options to extend, for the provision of an independent-leg cantilever jack-up drilling rig, the Admarine 502, for the drilling of six development wells and the installation of the CSF to support the development of the Mako Gas Field. A sharing arrangement for the rig has been agreed with another operator, allowing the sharing of mobilisation/demobilisation costs between the parties.
CSF
: contract with PT PAL Indonesia (“
PT PAL
”) with scope of work including (i) detailed engineering, (ii) procurement, (iii) construction and assembly of the jacket and topside structures, and (iv) transportation.
Engineering and procurement are ongoing, with some steel shipments already on site and others in transit. The first cut of a beam fabrication commenced on 14 September 26.
SURF
: contract with PT Timas Suplindo (“
Timas
”) with scope of work including (i) verification of front-end engineering and design and execution of a detailed engineering design, (ii) procurement, management, storage, and integration of materials, (iii) construction and assembly, coating and inspection of subsea structures and associated SURF components, (iv) transportation and installation, and (v) pre-commissioning and commissioning support.
Engineering and procurement are ongoing, and significant work has been completed to optimise the offshore sequence in conjunction with drilling activities to minimise simultaneous operations. Site fabrication will commence mid-4Q 26. The contract remains on track.
WNEL has signed contracts and/or issued letters of award/variation orders covering 90% of project capital contracts. Total project cost remains at US$320 million for the Mako gas project. In addition, the MOPU contract requires payment of US$4 million for the purchase of a donor rig and a US$26 million facility equipment down payment, which is accounted for as part of a previously announced provision of approximately US$35 million (100%).
As reported previously, PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia (“
PLN EPI
”), the contracted buyer of 100% of the gas from the Mako Gas Project, completed the "hot tap" connection on the West Natuna Transportation System (“
WNTS
”) to the Pemping gas pipeline project, which is the delivery point for Mako’s gas into Batam. This marked an important step in developing infrastructure that will connect the West Natuna Basin to Batam. Commissioning is scheduled to take place once the Onshore Receiving Facility is deemed ready and gas is available for commissioning purposes. Based on the current plan, commissioning is projected for during September / October 2026 (well in advance of any gas supply from Mako).
Data centre-driven power demand in Batam is booming, with Conrad now evaluating opportunities within its portfolio to increase gas supply to the area.
Empyrean CEO, Gaz Bisht, commented:
“We are very pleased with the continued progress at Mako, with a number of important development milestones now achieved and the major project workstreams progressing in line with plan. The project remains on budget and on track for first gas in the fourth quarter of 2027.
Mako is also strategically well positioned. The project will supply gas into Batam, which is emerging as an important regional data centre and industrial hub within the Singapore–Johor–Riau economic corridor. The rapid growth in power demand across the region is creating increasing demand for reliable gas-fired power generation and reinforces the importance of Mako’s future gas supply.
With the major contracts now substantially committed and construction activities progressing across the MOPU, drilling, CSF and SURF workstreams, we look forward to further milestones as the project advances towards production.
For Empyrean, Mako provides a significant long-term exposure to gas production and cash flow, while our recently announced entry into Austria provides an additional near-term development opportunity as we continue to build a broader portfolio of gas assets.”

latest.content:
16 Sep 2026 07:00

Empyrean Energy PLC

16 September 2026
This announcement contains inside information
Empyrean Energy PLC / Index: AIM / Epic: EME / Sector: Oil & Gas
Empyrean Energy PLC (‘Empyrean’ or ‘the Company’)
Completion of Equity Capital Raising
Empyrean Energy plc (
“Empyrean”
or the
“Company”
), the oil and gas exploration and development company with interests in Australia, Indonesia, and the United States, is pleased to advise that it has successfully raised gross proceeds of £1,000,000 through a placing of 2,000,000,000 new ordinary shares of 0.01p each in the Company (the "
Placing Shares
") at a price of 0.05p per Placing Share (the "
Issue Price
") (the "
Placing
").
CMC Markets Plc, trading as CMC CapX, is the Company’s placing agent in respect of the Placing.
On 14 September 2026, Empyrean announced that it had entered into a binding Heads of Agreement ("
BHoA
") with ADX VIE GmbH ("
ADX.V
”) and that, in order to capitalise on the significant opportunity presented through participation in the GOLD Cluster project and to the fund its share of the costs envisaged under the BHoA, the Company required to raise additional capital.
The net proceeds from the Placing will be used to fund Empyrean’s share of costs under the BHoA for the drilling of the GOLD-1 exploration well located within the GOLD Cluster of ADX-AT-II licence area located within the Molasse Basin of Upper Austria, as well as for its general working capital purposes.
ADX.V is planning to commence drilling of the GOLD-1 exploration well in Q4 2026.
Empyrean’s investment commitment in a success case of approximately €555,400 (approximately £476,672) represents 20% of the estimated €2.777 million GOLD-1 well cost cap. Empyrean will earn a 10% economic interest in the GOLD Cluster through participation in a partnership to be established under Austrian law.
ADX.V is a wholly-owned subsidiary of ADX Energy Ltd (ASX: ADX), an ASX listed oil & gas exploration and production company focussed on projects in Austria, Romania and Italy.
The Placing is conditional on the Placing Shares being admitted to trading on the AIM market operated by London Stock Exchange plc ("Admission"). Admission is expected to take place on 22 September 2026.
Following Admission, the Company will have 7,719,672,441 existing Ordinary Shares in issue. This figure may be used by shareholders of the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
As detailed in the Company's announcement of 14 September 2026, the Company entered a Capital Access Window at 7.30 a.m. on 14 September 2026 in order to achieve pricing stability during the conduct of the Placing.
Following the results of the Placing, the Capital Access Window has now closed and normal trading in the Company's existing Ordinary Shares is expected to resume at 7.30 a.m. today, 16 September 2026.
Empyrean CEO, Gaz Bisht, commented:
“The past 12 months have been challenging for Empyrean on several fronts; however, we have recently seen some particularly positive developments, having firstly secured our economic interest position in the Mako gas project, and secondly, through the completion of the NNB transaction last week, which represents a major milestone for Empyrean.
The Mako project is now fully funded, development activities are advancing, and first gas is targeted for Q4 2027 in one of the world’s fastest-growing energy consumption regions.
With Mako providing a strong foundation, the Board and management have broadened Empyrean’s focus to identify opportunities with attractive geological characteristics, near-term development potential and a clear pathway to cash flow
.
The acquisition of an interest in the GOLD Cluster in Upper Austria provides Empyrean with exposure to an exciting near-term drilling campaign, complementing our longer-term exposure to Mako
While acknowledging this funding round is dilutive, it provides Empyrean with a significant growth opportunity and we hope to see this reflected in shareholder value through a successful drilling campaign and the continued progress at Mako.
”

latest.title: Acquisition of Interest in GOLD Cluster
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 6016U
Empyrean Energy PLC
14 September 2026
This announcement contains inside information
Empyrean Energy PLC / Index: AIM / Epic: EME / Sector: Oil & Gas
Empyrean Energy PLC (‘Empyrean’ or ‘the Company’)
Acquisition of Interest in GOLD Cluster, Upper Austria
Intention to Undertake an Equity Capital Raising
Empyrean Energy plc (
“Empyrean”
or the
“Company”
), the oil and gas exploration and development company with interests in Australia, Indonesia, and the United States, is pleased to announce that it has entered into a binding Heads of Agreement ("BHoA") with ADX VIE GmbH ("
ADX.V
") in relation to the acquisition of a 10% economic interest in the GOLD Cluster, located within the ADX-AT-II licence area in Upper Austria.
The GOLD Cluster comprises the GOLD, ZAUN and GRAB shallow gas prospects located within the Molasse Basin of Upper Austria and covers approximately 73 km² within the ADX-AT-II licence area, in which ADX.V currently holds a 100% interest. ADX.V is planning to commence drilling of the GOLD-1 exploration well in 4th quarter 2026.
ADX.V is a wholly-owned subsidiary of ADX Energy Ltd (ASX: ADX), an ASX listed oil & gas exploration and production company focussed on projects in Austria, Romania and Italy.
Highlights
Binding Heads of Agreement executed with ADX.V for an option to EarnFarm-in to the GOLD Cluster Austrian Gas Projectin Upper Austria.
GOLD Cluster comprises the GOLD, ZAUN and GRAB gas prospects covering approximately 73 km².
Empyrean to earn a 10% economic interest in the GOLD Cluster through participation in a partnership to be established under Austrian law.
The GOLD Cluster comprises three shallow gas prospects — GOLD, ZAUN and GRAB — offering multiple follow-ups drilling targets beyond the initial GOLD well.
The GOLD prospect is supported by 3D seismic data, including a strong Class 3 AVO amplitude anomaly (“
GOLD A
”); technical work by Empyrean has assessed the prospect as a stratigraphic pinch-out / compartmentalised sand-body play, with GOLD A interpreted as a separate, down-dip target to the previously drilled GUGG-001 well that produced commercial gas.
Total investment commitment in a success of approximately €555,400, representing 20% of the estimated €2.777 million GOLD-1 well cost cap.
Initial option fee of €50,000 payable upon execution of the BHOA.
ADX to remain operator of the project.
Planned drilling of the GOLD-1 exploration well in 4
th
Quarter 2026.
Transaction Summary
Under the terms of the BHoA, Empyrean will pay ADX.V an option fee of €50,000 upon execution of the agreement.
Subject to execution of a definitive Energy Investment Agreement ("
EIA
"), Empyrean will make a further payment of €120,600, representing its share of pre-drill costs for the GOLD-1 well, less the option fee already paid.
Following issuance of the GOLD-1 well Authorisation for Expenditure ("
AFE
") and satisfaction of certain conditions, including provision of a signed drilling contract and drilling schedule, Empyrean will contribute a further €434,800.
The aggregate investment of €555,400 represents 20% of the estimated €2.777 million GOLD-1 well cost cap and, upon payment in full, will entitle Empyrean to a 10% economic interest in the GOLD Cluster.
The economic interest will be held through a partnership to be established for hydrocarbon exploration, development and production activities within the GOLD Cluster area. Empyrean will be entitled to receive 10% of net revenues generated by the partnership after payment of royalties and will be responsible for 10% of future project expenditures in accordance with the definitive agreements.
Empyrean will not acquire a direct participating interest in the ADX-AT-II licence and ADX.V will remain operator of the project.
Background to GOLD Cluster
ADX VIE GmbH is the Austrian operating subsidiary and European headquarters of ADX Energy Ltd ("ADX"), an ASX-listed oil and gas company focused on exploration, appraisal, development and production opportunities in Europe.
ADX entered Austria in 2019 and became a European-focused producer, developer and explorer through the acquisition of the long-life producing Gaiselberg and Zistersdorf oil fields, making it one of only three production operators in Austria at the time. Since then, ADX has built a multi-disciplinary management, technical and operations team based in Vienna.
Since 2025, ADX has completed extensive technical evaluation of 3D seismic data and legacy well data across its Austrian acreage, maturing several low-risk shallow gas prospects – including three prospects, GOLD, ZAUN and GRAB – within the GOLD Cluster, located within the ADX-AT-II licence area in Upper Austria.
Following completion of prospect maturation, permitting activities, and the publication of prospective resource estimates for the cluster, ADX commenced a farm-out process to secure a funding partner for the planned drilling programme.
The GOLD prospect is supported by 3D seismic data, including a strong Class 3 AVO amplitude anomaly ("
GOLD A
"). Technical work by Empyrean has assessed the prospect as a stratigraphic pinch-out / compartmentalised sand-body play, with GOLD A interpreted as a separate, down-dip target to the previously drilled GUGG-001 well, which produced commercial gas. The transaction with Empyrean Energy plc is intended to support drilling of the GOLD-1 exploration well and the subsequent appraisal and development of the broader cluster.
Empyrean’s Intention to Undertake an Equity Capital Raising
In order to capitalise on the significant opportunity presented through participation in the GOLD Cluster project and to the fund its share of the costs envisaged under the BHoA, the Company requires to raise additional capital.
Accordingly, the Company is actively considering a placing of new ordinary shares to new and existing investors (the "
Proposed Fundraising
").
This announcement does not constitute an offer of securities in any jurisdiction. The Proposed Fundraising, if implemented, will be the subject of further announcements, which will be made as and when appropriate.
The Proposed Fundraising of is being arranged by the Company's placing agent, CMC Markets Plc, trading as CMC CapX.
The net proceeds will be used to fund Empyrean’s investment commitment under the BHoA of €555,400 (approximately £476,672) with remaining funds to be used for the Company’s general working capital purposes.
Capital Access Window
Following the recent amendments to the AIM Rules for Companies, the Company intends to utilise the newly introduced Capital Access Window facility in connection with the Proposed Fundraising.
The AIM Rules Capital Access Window facility provides the Company with a voluntary mechanism to implement a temporary pause in trading in its securities, and the Company has elected to utilise this facility in order to achieve pricing stability during the Proposed Fundraising.
Accordingly, trading in the Company's Ordinary Shares will enter a Capital Access Window trading halt with effect from 7.30 a.m. today. The Company will provide a further announcement in due course.

company_30s.what_they_do: EME.L is a small UK‑listed energy group that owns and develops oil, gas and gold assets.  Its core activities include offshore drilling operations (the new Mako rig), exploration of a gold cluster in the UK, and the management of a modest portfolio of renewable‑energy projects.
company_30s.why_they_matter: The company sits at the intersection of two high‑growth sectors: gold mining, which is gaining traction as a safe‑haven, and offshore oil drilling, where technology and cost efficiencies are improving.  If the gold cluster and the Mako rig deliver early production, EME.L could become a niche play that attracts institutional interest.
company_30s.current_state: EME.L is in a rebuilding phase after a recent series of capital‑raising events.  It is still heavily cash‑burning but has secured a short‑term capital access window and is working to bring the Mako rig online.  The shares trade in a very low price range, reflecting the company’s precarious liquidity position.

rns_narrative: The company has been busy securing funding and expanding its asset base.  The latest announcements cover a capital‑access window, acquisition of a gold‑mining interest, and the signing of a drilling‑rig contract.  These moves suggest a deliberate shift from a cash‑burning startup to a company focused on asset development.
A second theme is corporate governance: the board has changed and a new CEO was appointed in February, signalling a fresh strategy.
The third cluster is financial: the company is actively raising equity and debt to support the Mako rig and the gold cluster, indicating that it is looking for a catalyst to lift the share price.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Quiet optimism, with most chatter focused on upcoming drilling results and gold‑cluster potential.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: Bulls argue that the gold cluster could deliver quick cash flow and the Mako rig will position the company for a mid‑term upside once production starts.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Bears point to the company’s thin cash runway, high debt load and the fact that many of the announced projects are still in the exploration phase.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: Sentiment has been largely neutral but has trended slightly bullish after the capital‑access announcement, as traders see a potential for a surprise rally.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends is flat – no public search interest, which means a sudden news event could create a big surprise.

near_term_catalysts: The next quarterly results (2 September) could show whether the company has moved any drilling activity into production.
A successful completion of the capital‑access window (14 September) would inject liquidity and potentially lift the stock.
Positive drilling data from the Mako rig, if released before the end of September, could act as a trigger.
Any announcement that the gold cluster has moved to the development stage would be a strong catalyst.
expect_next.watch_for: Key signals: 1) A jump in trading volume above the 20‑day average; 2) A price break above the 50‑day moving average; 3) Confirmation that the company has closed its capital‑access window and has a cash balance to fund the rig; 4) A press release indicating that the gold cluster has moved to a production‑ready status.
expect_next.timing_regime: The share price appears to be in the early stages of a crash‑recovery cycle – the last major dip was several months ago and volume has been low.  A bounce would likely require a catalyst that confirms the company’s new strategy, after which the market will begin to re‑price the assets.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: If the company delivers on the Mako rig and gold‑cluster milestones, the price could rise to 50% of its 52‑week high – a 4× return from today’s level.  The deep crash (70‑95% off the peak) gives a large upside window while the low current price keeps the downside limited.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The biggest risk is that the company fails to raise enough capital or that the rig and gold projects stall, leaving the share price stuck below 0.05p.  A failure to hit the capital‑access window would make it difficult to fund operations, potentially leading to a liquidation scenario.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential upside: 4× the current price.  Potential downside: 100% of the current price (if the share drops to zero).  The asymmetry is roughly 4:1, favouring the bullish thesis if a catalyst materialises.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter after a clear volume spike and a break above the 50‑day moving average.  Size the position so that a 10% drop from the entry price would trigger a stop‑loss.  Use a trailing stop at 15% below the peak to lock in gains while protecting against a sudden reversal.
playbook.if_watching: Wait for either the capital‑access announcement to be confirmed or for a positive drilling update from the Mako rig.  If the price climbs to 1.2× the current level with volume > 1.5× the 20‑day average, consider a partial entry.
playbook.if_passing: Only consider abandoning the trade if the company files for bankruptcy or is delisted from the LSE.  Otherwise, stay bullish on the deep‑crash play.

ai_insights.bottom_line: A heavily discounted energy and gold play that, if its capital‑access and drilling milestones materialise, could trigger a sharp bounce, offering a high‑reward, low‑risk contrarian opportunity.
